nodes.label: auth-visual :: panel (Evolucion del vidrio)
nodes.rationale: Left panel of login/registro illustrating glass manufacturing in 5 stages (materia prima, fusion, flotado sobre estano, templado, tu pieza). Placed after <main> in HTML so keyboard reaches the form first; CSS moves it left. Without JS shows stage 5; with prefers-reduced-motion or photosensitive mode it does not auto-advance. Purely illustrative, does not touch contract calculations.
